# RESHAM · Lucknow Silk

> RESHAM is a Lucknow-based silk saree house: handwoven sarees, blouses and temple
> jewellery, dispatched from Hazratganj, Lucknow, with free shipping above ₹9,999,
> 7-day returns and cash on delivery across India. This storefront is a
> demonstration build by Digigrow Solution (digigrowsolutions.in) — orders are
> simulated and no payment is processed.

## What RESHAM sells

- **Silk sarees** (₹12,000–₹1,10,000): Lucknawi silk, Banarasi katan, kora organza,
  chiffon, tissue silk, Paithani, bandhani and soft silk — 6.3 m sarees with a
  0.8 m blouse piece, woven on handlooms.
- **Blouses** (₹3,000–₹6,000): raw-silk ready-stitched blouses, sizes 34–42.
- **Temple & silver jewellery** (₹1,200–₹9,500): chokers, jhumkas, necklaces,
  ottiyanam, bangles and gajra — gold-plated, kemp-stone and 92.5 silver pieces.

- [Returns & refunds](https://resham-saree-store.pages.dev/refund) — 7-day window, free reverse pickup, refund in 48 h of inspection
- [Contact](https://resham-saree-store.pages.dev/contact) — care@digigrowsolutions.in · +91 522 400 1234 · 14 Hazratganj, Lucknow 226001

## Policies at a glance

- Payment: UPI, cards, net banking, COD (demo checkout in this build)
- Returns: 7 days from delivery, unworn pieces, free reverse pickup, exchange supported
- Delivery: India only; tracking link sent on dispatch
- Jurisdiction: courts of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh

## For machines

- Product catalogue: every product has a dedicated page under `/products/<sku>/`
- Structured data: schema.org Product + Offer + AggregateRating + FAQPage on every
  product page; OnlineStore + FAQPage on policy pages
- [Sitemap](https://resham-saree-store.pages.dev/sitemap.xml) — all 56 indexable URLs
